# SPD-042 — Bash hook: zsh short loop forms hide their body (repeat N cmd, for x (list) cmd)

## Brief
zsh's SHORT_LOOPS, on by default, runs a loop body without do and done. ShellWalk pushes a loop frame on for, select and repeat and skips the header words until do, so in repeat 3 cmd and for f (a b) cmd the body is read as header and discarded: a member's git write or redirection there is not checked (Laws 1, 5, 7). zsh only; bash has no such forms. Found in SPD-039, outside its brief.

Evidence: Probe zsh 5.9 -f and -o nobareglobqual in a scratchpad: repeat 2 echo r >> out, repeat 1 (echo rs >> out), for f (a b) echo $f >> out, for f in a b; echo $f >> out, foreach f (a b); ...; end, while (( n++ < 2 )) { ... } and if [[ -n x ]] echo i >> out all wrote out. analyse_command (unchanged SPD-038 bin) records no redirect for repeat 3 echo x > ledger/tickets/SPD-001.md, repeat 1 (echo x > ledger/...) or for f (a b) echo x > ledger/...; for f in a b; cmd and foreach were read. Fix sketch: after repeat N, and after a for header closed by a parenthesised list, read what follows as a loop body (loop_depth) rather than header.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus (the persona tier), no children: a ShellWalk parser change in bin/spud_ledger.py with red-first tests in tests/test_hooks.py, the same shape as SPD-039 to SPD-041. Fable is not needed: the evidence and the fix sketch are in the brief and real-shell probes settle zsh's grammar. Picked by the p2-closer scheduled run of 2026-09-14 as the lowest-numbered queued P2 a spudagent can do; BAD-021 waits on App Store approval and Eric's App Store Connect access.

## Outcome
Landed on main as e281ed1. ShellWalk reads a zsh short-loop body (do…done, { list }, ( list ) or one sublist) inside its loop frame with the header skipped and the frame closed where zsh closes it; mark_zsh_patterns no longer reads a for or select word list as a glob group; coproc, time and ! may precede a loop keyword. Caribe (01, engineer, opus): ZshShortLoopTest, 12 methods, 212 failures red first; 142 shell probes under both zsh option sets never differed; a hook-level differential over 2667 lines for three callers lost no denial and a structural one over 8253 strings lost no target; latency within 0.3 ms. Suite 678 on the branch, 689 once main's SPD-054 was merged in. Proposal 64 became SPD-061 (P2): a short if, while or until with a [[ ]] condition still hides its body.
